dex.entry: A mid-stage moon-spirit that has grown a veil of dark mist around its crescent core; it whispers in a frequency that plants doubt and unease in the minds of those who hear it. The cute crescent sprite grew into a whispering dusk-wraith — one of those rare mid-stages worth using in its own right.
